content.name: 员工数量
content.description: 根据员工的年龄数组，计算出他们的人数。
content.title: sizeof()运算符

resolved.title: 员工总数
resolved.problem_statement_md:
你得到一个整数数组，代表办公室里每个员工的年龄（见代码）。
你需要获得员工的数量，但由于数量太多，无法手工计算。

写一条语句，计算员工的总数，并输出。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The sizeof() Operator[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are given an array of integers which represents the ages of each employee in the office (see template). You need to obtain the number of employees, but there are too many to count manually.
Write a statement that will calculate the elements count defined in array and output the count.

[note]Use operator sizeof() to get the overall size of memory allocated by the array and the size of one element in that array.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 使用运算符`sizeof()`来获得数组分配的内存总大小和该数组中一个元素的大小。
